name: Zombies At The Beach
summary:
💩 Protect the beach from pooping zombies 💩

It started as a normal day at the coast: bikinis, barbecues, beach balls. Then the undead washed ashore. No one knows where they came from, maybe a sunken cruise ship? Government experiment? Too many tacos? Doesn’t matter. What matters is that they’re relentless, and their digestive systems are somehow still fully functional. They're groaning, stumbling, and squatting... and you're the only one who can stop the mess.
